situation: Old mates from uni in a group chat.
topic: Going over the night before: how drunk they all got, who was sick, what nobody can remember.

text: Ok who was sick last night. I've got a vague memory of a taxi with my head out the window but might be a different night
It was you. Sick in the bin outside the pub then again in the taxi. Matt held your hair
Ah
Was I the only one
Not the only one. I was on shift at 7 today so I'm not talking about it
It wasn't me though
It was jess. At the bar. She said it was the prosecco 😂
It was not the prosecco
It was the fourth tequila jess
I genuinely can't remember getting home
You got home. I saw you text matt at 2am about a pizza
I didn't get a pizza
I got a text about a pizza and I think I was asleep
Just out of handover. Nobody talk to me 😴
Ok matt's dinner. I'm thinking the 12th or 13th of december, somewhere in the centre. I'll look at a few places
13th is fine for me. 12th I'm on
Sounds good. Don't spend too long on it
Booked the table at the one on park street for the 13th at 7. 8 people max. Sending the link in a sec
[link: restaurant booking for Sat 13 Dec, 19:00]
Nice. Is it the one with the bread
Yes ben it's the one with the bread
Morning. Year 10 have decided they're all doing their mocks in pencil and it's causing a incident
Pencil is so much worse for the exam board. Do they know that
They know everything. That's the problem
Is anyone allergic to anything for the 13th. Isla's going to ask anyway so may as well
Yes I was going to ask. Anyone with dietary stuff reply here please
Nothing for me. I eat everything including the bread
Ben's the bread man
Ben you are not on this chat to make jokes about bread
I'm on this chat for the bread
Site meeting ran over so I missed the rest of the morning. Any updates
Only that Ben is a bread man now
Off shift at 8 tomorrow so I'm going to be dead for the 13th unless someone else is working that day
Not sure I'm dead for the 12th either haha
Ok I'll put you down for the 13th and you can tell me if you need to swap
Also has anyone heard from Ruth about the stag? Not sure she's coming
Didn't know there was a stag. Whose
Gary's. Not Matt. Relax
Relax 😂
Anyone up. Mocks are finally done marking and I need to talk about something that isn't a pencil
Up. What's the something
Nothing much. Just tired of being the one who knows where the spare stapler is 😴
Home. Not asleep yet. Don't ask
Asking anyway. How was it
A man who wanted to know if I was "the proper doctor". Yes Matt I am the proper doctor
😂 that's the worst of it
No the worst of it is I'm back on at 7 tomorrow night
Pen up the nose is a classic though
Locked myself out of the flat in my socks. Landlord is 40 mins away. Sitting on the stairs with a flat white like a crazy person
Where's your key
In the flat. Obviously
Is there a window open
Don't
Locksmith is coming. £90 for the privilege
Ouch
Back-to-back site visits all afternoon. Client wants the atrium lower. Again
Lower the atrium
Ben that's not how buildings work
I know. I'm mourning the atrium
Ben what was the something last night. You went quiet
Honestly it's fine. Head's moved me to Year 7 next year. Not a disaster just a lot. Will tell you properly at the dinner with a drink in me
Ok. Drink at the dinner it is
Back in. £85 and a man called Dev who had to go through my bag twice. Got in. Still in socks
Hero
Also I've had the worst call with Sarah on the Hartley account and I'm going to need a long walk and a lot of cheese
Sorry Isla. Hartley?
Yes. Hartley. They want the whole deck redone for a board that is apparently "very interested" in something they haven't defined
Classic
Awake. Mostly. What's the dinner menu situation, I'm assuming there is one
No menu. It's a restaurant Jess. They have menus
💀 ok thanks
Bread
Ben
Matt did you see the photos Ruth sent from the 2008 house? There's one of you in a Hawaiian shirt that should be legally protected
No. Send
[photo: five people on a sofa, one in a hawaiian shirt]
Who is the man in the shirt
You
Ok
Ruth says she's in for Gary's stag. Didn't say why she wasn't before
Ok good. Gary will cry
Got to bed at 11, woke up at 1 thinking about a patient and now I'm just here
Nobody answer this
Nobody answering
